title: TMP Camera Surveillance Next 2.20.64
summary: Bring up 25-camera fleets faster with four bounded parallel starts, 250 ms ingest staggering and faster kiosk tile attachment.
changes: Allow four concurrent independent camera starts while preserving per-camera serialization and bounded recovery
Reduce central preview start staggering from 1500 to 250 ms
Migrate only existing default .env startup values while retaining custom administrator settings
Shorten kiosk tile attachment staggering without requesting new camera sessions
Preserve recording, motion, stream fallback and browser HLS buffer behavior
name: TMP Camera Surveillance Next v2.20.64
description: Faster bounded central camera bootstrap, kiosk playback attachment and migration of previous startup defaults.
releaseNotes: Compatible from 2.20.32. Central preview ingestion starts at up to four cameras at once with a 250 ms enqueue interval; previous default settings are migrated without overriding custom values. Existing camera, recording and motion configuration is preserved.
